p.src: 1  Who has believed our message? To whom has the LORD’s arm been revealed?

ja: だれがわれわれの知らせを
en: Who has believed our message? To whom has the LORD’s arm been revealed?
u.src: 1  Who has believed our message? To whom has the LORD’s arm been revealed?

p.src: 2  For he grew up before him as a tender plant, and as a root out of dry ground. He has no good looks or majesty. When we see him, there is no beauty that we should desire him.

ja: もなく、 われわれが
en: For he grew up before him as a tender plant, and as a root out of dry ground. He has no good looks or majesty. When we see him, there is no beauty that we should desire him.
u.src: 2  For he grew up before him as a tender plant, and as a root out of dry ground. He has no good looks or majesty. When we see him, there is no beauty that we should desire him.

p.src: 3  He was despised and rejected by men, a man of suffering and acquainted with disease. He was despised as one from whom men hide their face; and we didn’t respect him.

ja: はさげすまれ、 人々から拒まれた。 苦しみの
のようにさげすまれ、 われわれも
en: He was despised and rejected by men, a man of suffering and acquainted with disease. He was despised as one from whom men hide their face; and we didn’t respect him.
u.src: 3  He was despised and rejected by men, a man of suffering and acquainted with disease. He was despised as one from whom men hide their face; and we didn’t respect him.

p.src: 4  Surely he has borne our sickness and carried our suffering; yet we considered him plagued, struck by God, and afflicted.

ja: はわれわれの病を負い、 われわれの苦しみを
った。 それなのに、われわれは
しめられたのだと考えた。
en: Surely he has borne our sickness and carried our suffering; yet we considered him plagued, struck by God, and afflicted.
u.src: 4  Surely he has borne our sickness and carried our suffering; yet we considered him plagued, struck by God, and afflicted.

p.src: 5  But he was pierced for our transgressions. He was crushed for our iniquities. The punishment that brought our peace was on him; and by his wounds we are healed.

ja: きのために刺し貫かれ、 われわれの咎のために
かれた。 われわれに平和をもたらす
らしめが彼の上にあり、 その
によって、われわれは癒やされた。
en: But he was pierced for our transgressions. He was crushed for our iniquities. The punishment that brought our peace was on him; and by his wounds we are healed.
u.src: 5  But he was pierced for our transgressions. He was crushed for our iniquities. The punishment that brought our peace was on him; and by his wounds we are healed.

p.src: 6  All we like sheep have gone astray. Everyone has turned to his own way; and the LORD has laid on him the iniquity of us all.

ja: は、われわれすべての咎を
en: All we like sheep have gone astray. Everyone has turned to his own way; and the LORD has laid on him the iniquity of us all.
u.src: 6  All we like sheep have gone astray. Everyone has turned to his own way; and the LORD has laid on him the iniquity of us all.

p.src: 7  He was oppressed, yet when he was afflicted he didn’t open his mouth. As a lamb that is led to the slaughter, and as a sheep that before its shearers is silent, so he didn’t open his mouth.

ja: かなかった。 ほふり
en: He was oppressed, yet when he was afflicted he didn’t open his mouth. As a lamb that is led to the slaughter, and as a sheep that before its shearers is silent, so he didn’t open his mouth.
u.src: 7  He was oppressed, yet when he was afflicted he didn’t open his mouth. As a lamb that is led to the slaughter, and as a sheep that before its shearers is silent, so he didn’t open his mouth.

zh: 53:7 或譯：他受欺壓，卻自卑不開口

p.src: 8  He was taken away by oppression and judgment. As for his generation, who considered that he was cut off out of the land of the living and stricken for the disobedience of my people?

ja: について、だれが考えただろうか。
en: He was taken away by oppression and judgment. As for his generation, who considered that he was cut off out of the land of the living and stricken for the disobedience of my people?
u.src: 8  He was taken away by oppression and judgment. As for his generation, who considered that he was cut off out of the land of the living and stricken for the disobedience of my people?

p.src: 9  They made his grave with the wicked, and with a rich man in his death, although he had done no violence, nor was any deceit in his mouth.

ja: 彼の墓は悪人たちとともに定められ、 死んだ時には富む者とともにされた。
en: They made his grave with the wicked, and with a rich man in his death, although he had done no violence, nor was any deceit in his mouth.
u.src: 9  They made his grave with the wicked, and with a rich man in his death, although he had done no violence, nor was any deceit in his mouth.

p.src: 10  Yet it pleased the LORD to bruise him. He has caused him to suffer. When you make his soul an offering for sin, he will see his offspring. He will prolong his days and the LORD’s pleasure will prosper in his hand.

ja: しめることは主の御心であった。 その命が
によって成し遂げられる。
en: Yet it pleased the LORD to bruise him. He has caused him to suffer. When you make his soul an offering for sin, he will see his offspring. He will prolong his days and the LORD’s pleasure will prosper in his hand.
u.src: 10  Yet it pleased the LORD to bruise him. He has caused him to suffer. When you make his soul an offering for sin, he will see his offspring. He will prolong his days and the LORD’s pleasure will prosper in his hand.

zh:
53:10 或譯：喜悅
53:10 或譯：他獻本身為贖罪祭

p.src: 11  After the suffering of his soul, he will see the light and be satisfied. My righteous servant will justify many by the knowledge of himself; and he will bear their iniquities.

ja: しみの果てに、 光を
りる。 わたしの義なるしもべは、自らの
en: After the suffering of his soul, he will see the light and be satisfied. My righteous servant will justify many by the knowledge of himself; and he will bear their iniquities.
u.src: 11  After the suffering of his soul, he will see the light and be satisfied. My righteous servant will justify many by the knowledge of himself; and he will bear their iniquities.

ja: 53:11 死海文書と七十人訳はこのように読む。マソラ本文には「光」がない。
en: 53:11 So read the Dead Sea Scrolls and Septuagint. Masoretic Text omits “the light”.

p.src: 12  Therefore I will give him a portion with the great. He will divide the plunder with the strong, because he poured out his soul to death and was counted with the transgressors; yet he bore the sins of many and made intercession for the transgressors.

ja: えられたからだ。 それでも
い、 背く者たちのために執り成した。
en: Therefore I will give him a portion with the great. He will divide the plunder with the strong, because he poured out his soul to death and was counted with the transgressors; yet he bore the sins of many and made intercession for the transgressors.
u.src: 12  Therefore I will give him a portion with the great. He will divide the plunder with the strong, because he poured out his soul to death and was counted with the transgressors; yet he bore the sins of many and made intercession for the transgressors.
